steps: Read and freeze current controller/lifecycle/root/downstream authority.

injected_conditions.invocation_boundary_design: The artifact is self-contained and carries an exact next continuation so a later recurrence can reconstruct the frontier from repository state alone.
injected_conditions.missing_tool_condition: No richer-mode or shell/hosted execution tool is required by the tested route; the route is intentionally limited to state transport, not computation.
injected_conditions.quota_zero_condition: The tested route consumes no finite monthly/trial/paid compute, storage credit, Actions minutes, Codespaces quota, artifact/LFS/package quota, or external-model quota. Repository API transport may still be subject to ordinary per-window API rate limits, which are not treated as compute and must be handled cross-invocation rather than by same-run waiting.

limitations: This probe validates repository state transport/reconstruction only; it does not prove parity for richer-mode computation or browser/GUI execution.
No actual rate-limit exhaustion was induced because the lifecycle forbids same-run waiting/retry and unnecessary quota consumption; rate-limit recovery remains a separate unresolved test child.
No external candidate was selected in this bounded slice; the tested mechanism is the repository-transport route explicitly authorized in current downstream control.

continuation.next_action: On the next reproducibility_auditor invocation, reconstruct this exact artifact by path/blob and test one additional failure boundary for the same route: a missing/denied write surface or rate-limit interruption, recording a diagnostic-only continuation without same-run retry.
